user.title: Connect Lethe Messenger
user.description: Enter the address of your Lethe server and the name Home Assistant uses to message you in Lethe. A QR code appears in the next step.

expired.title: QR code expired
expired.description: The QR code was not scanned within 5 minutes. Submit to create a new one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Lethe
reauth_confirm.description: The bot token for “{bot_name}” has become invalid (e.g. because the bot was deleted in Lethe). Confirm to sign in again via QR code – a new bot will be created and the stored token updated.

progress.wait_scan:
In the Lethe app open **Settings → Linked devices → Scan QR code** and scan this code:

![QR code]({qr_url})

The code is valid for 5 minutes. This dialog continues automatically once scanned.

abort.already_configured: This Lethe account is already configured.
abort.setup_failed: Setup failed (bot could not be created). See the Home Assistant log.
abort.wrong_account: The scanned QR code belongs to a different Lethe account. Please sign in with the original account to reauthenticate this integration.

add_rule.title: New rule
add_rule.description:
When one of the selected entities meets the condition, the message is sent (once per transition, not repeated while the state stays the same).

Templates are allowed, e.g. {tpl_help}.

data_description.value: e.g. on, off, open, home or a number. Leave empty for “Any change”.

error.value_not_number: For greater/less than the value must be a number.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a message to you via Lethe.
